summary: No reachable security issues. Trust boundary unchanged: heads-up.json and full-ring.json are bundled, project-authored data parsed at import by the existing parseChart; the only change to the validator is accepting three reference sizes via an allow-list (REFERENCE_SIZES.includes), so unknown sizes still fail closed. Prototype-key robustness holds: spot lookup is by matching against the fixed APPLICABLE_SPOTS list (unknown/'__proto__' keys rejected with a 20-char echo), duplicates go through a Map, cells are keyed only by handClassAt() output, and chartCell guards with Object.hasOwn; malformed tokens/rows/grids are collected as problems and throw ChartValidationError. Advice reads only the PlayerView (referenceSizeOf/positionOf/situationOf/chartSpotOf use view.players, view.button, view.seat, view.actions, view.holeCards); recommendPreflop/PreflopOptions take no style, and advice-service.ts is unchanged, so a bot's style is passed only to decideBot, never to the user's advice/grading path. A chart/table-size mismatch now throws (fail closed). Rock maps onto its 6-max range via chartSpotOf(view,'6-max'). Randomness unchanged (seeded botRandom; the random-move fallback and its imports removed). The e2e pace harness now imports src/ui/advice/advice.worker.ts and is referenced only from e2e/support/table-harness-bundle.ts; nothing under src/ imports e2e code, and the test-only pace worker was deleted, so no test-only code ships. Justification text in the new charts reads as original authored prose (REQ-061); reference-charts.test.ts also checks originality against six-max.json. No new dependencies, network, secrets, or logging.
